name: Beacons
description: Beacons MCP gives you access to all your tools on Beacons, for creators and managers. Update your Link in Bio, Media Kit, Smart Replies, websites, and products. Check on your analytics for all of these. Access your connected social analytics. All your data you can access in the app is available on this MCP.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Beacons to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Beacons to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://beacons.ai/api/v001/creator/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Beacons MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Beacons lists 28 MCP tools, including add_media_kit_brand_partner, add_media_kit_case_study, add_media_kit_rate, add_media_kit_social_platform, generate_qr_code, get_creator_social_stats, get_email_marketing_analytics, get_firestore_document, get_invoice_analytics, get_media_kit_analytics, get_organization_creator_info, and get_organization_creator_link_analytics.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Beacons?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Beacons in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
Beacons requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Beacons is developed by Beacons. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
